constructors.rd23: scan_signals directly emits family rows; no union_events/standalone_events constructor contract
constructors.rd26: standalone_events and union_events consume normalized focus events
constructors.current_authority: UNION_FOCUS->union_events; two family rows->standalone_events across C2/D2/E2

universe.rd23: membership snapshots expose C2/D2/E2 identifiers in source loops; row presence not opened
universe.rd26: same effective membership source path is used for its own scan

pit.rd23: decision_time/effective_end and completed feature timestamps bound scan loop; source contract is for RD23 raw-edge diagnostics
pit.rd26: separate focus-event and administrative horizon contract

comparison.pair_normalization: Both source contracts use membership pair keys and raw_root/<pair>/1h.parquet; exact row-level equality is not claimed.

rd26_use_of_rd23: RD23 artifact is a frozen preflight/equivalence reference; RD26 does not use it as the writer input for signal-events-2022-2023.csv.
